name: Bach Ma Temple
kicker: Temple of the white horse at 76 Hang Buom
summary: Bach Ma is the small temple at 76 Hang Buom: yellow walls, a tiled roof with dragons along the ridge, red lanterns at the door, and a white horse on the altar inside. Step in from the lanes on the way to Dong Xuan; it is a stop on the walk, not a separate outing. Go in the day sessions, or on a Friday to Sunday evening.
heroCaption: The yellow hall, tiled roof, and dragons on Hang Buom

notice.title: Read the board at the gate
notice.body: Posted hours have changed over the years, and the weekend evening close is given as both 21:00 and 21:30. Check the board at the gate before you plan an evening visit.

body: The hall sits right on Hang Buom, at number 76: yellow walls, a tiled roof, dragons along the ridge, and red lanterns by the door. Inside, the altar centres on a white horse between two cranes. It is a short stop on the walk through the lanes, not a separate day.

From 8 December 2025 the ticket is 20,000 VND a visit. Under-16s go free (under 1.3 m if a child has no papers), and students 16 and over, older visitors, and the other listed groups pay half. Entry is also free on 23 November, on the last day of the lunar year, and on the first two days of Tet.
The day runs in two sessions, 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30, every day. On Friday, Saturday, and Sunday the temple opens again from 19:00 for the evening. The board at the gate has the last word.

figures.caption: The altar inside Bach Ma, with the white horse
figures.alt: The altar inside Bach Ma Temple, centered on a white horse between two cranes

gettingThere: The temple is at 76 Hang Buom, inside the lanes north of Hoan Kiem Lake. Walk north from the lake into the lanes, and pair it with Dong Xuan Market on the same walk.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: On foot, north into the lanes to 76 Hang Buom.

hours: 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30 daily; Friday–Sunday evening 19:00–21:30 (Vietnam National Administration of Tourism, Dec 2025) or 19:00–21:00 (VnExpress). A 2018 gate board showed 08:00–11:00 and 14:00–17:00, and 08:00–21:00 on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month. Check the board.
closed: No weekly close in the 2025 notice. The 2018 gate board showed Monday closed.
admissionNote: 20,000 VND a visit from 8 December 2025. Under 16 free, or under 1.3 m without papers. Severe disability free. Half price for students from 16, older visitors, and the other groups in the notice; qualifying twice still means half. Free on 23 November, the last lunar day, and the first two days of Tet (VnExpress).
